spec.description: Dashboard for network performance results collected by Adrianozk/ookla-speedtest-influxdb, including per-server analysis. Includes collection status, historical failures, freshness and explicit gaps. Requires Flux 0.179+ for typed nulls.

spec.query:
import "internal/debug"

values = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "download_mbps" or r._field == "upload_mbps")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

gaps = values
  |> elapsed(unit: 1s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.elapsed > int(v: "${max_age_seconds}"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: time(v: int(v: r._time) - 1000000), _field: r._field, _value: debug.null(type: "float")}))

failed = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}_status" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "success")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 0)

failed0 = failed |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: "download_mbps", _value: debug.null(type: "float")}))

failed1 = failed |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: "upload_mbps", _value: debug.null(type: "float")}))

union(tables: [values, gaps, failed0, failed1])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: Download and upload throughput over the selected time range. Raw samples; explicit failures and gaps longer than Max data age break the line. No zero speeds are invented. Prefer a shorter time range for high-frequency collectors.
spec.title: Throughput history

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_loss_pct")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: r._time) <= int(v: "${max_age_seconds}") * 1000000000)

spec.description: Latency, jitter, and packet loss over the selected time range. Packet loss uses the right axis. Raw samples; explicit failures and gaps longer than Max data age break the line. No zero speeds are invented. Prefer a shorter time range for high-frequency collectors.
spec.title: Connection quality

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "download_mbps" or r._field == "upload_mbps" or r._field == "latency_ms" or r._field == "jitter_ms" or r._field == "packet_loss_pct")
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "server_id", "server_name", "server_location", "server_country", "isp", "interface"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "download_mbps", "upload_mbps", "latency_ms", "jitter_ms", "packet_loss_pct", "server_name", "server_location", "server_country", "server_id", "isp", "interface"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "Time", download_mbps: "Download", upload_mbps: "Upload", latency_ms: "Latency", jitter_ms: "Jitter", packet_loss_pct: "Packet loss", server_name: "Server", server_location: "Location", server_country: "Country", server_id: "Server ID", isp: "ISP", interface: "Interface"})
  |> sort(columns: ["Time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 100)

spec.description: Most recent tests in the selected time range, newest first, including the server selected by Ookla.
spec.title: Recent tests

spec.query:
base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "download_mbps" or r._field == "upload_mbps" or r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["server_id", "server_name", "server_location", "server_country", "_field"])

minimum = base
  |> min()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: r._field + "_min"}))

average = base
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: r._field + "_avg"}))

maximum = base
  |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with metric: r._field + "_max"}))

tests = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "download_mbps")
  |> count(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value), metric: "tests"}))

union(tables: [minimum, average, maximum, tests])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["server_id", "server_name", "server_location", "server_country"], columnKey: ["metric"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["server_name", "server_id", "server_location", "server_country", "tests", "download_mbps_min", "download_mbps_avg", "download_mbps_max", "upload_mbps_min", "upload_mbps_avg", "upload_mbps_max", "latency_ms_min", "latency_ms_avg", "latency_ms_max"])
  |> rename(columns: {server_name: "Server", server_id: "Server ID", server_location: "Location", server_country: "Country", tests: "Tests", download_mbps_min: "Download min", download_mbps_avg: "Download avg", download_mbps_max: "Download max", upload_mbps_min: "Upload min", upload_mbps_avg: "Upload avg", upload_mbps_max: "Upload max", latency_ms_min: "Latency min", latency_ms_avg: "Latency avg", latency_ms_max: "Latency max"})
  |> sort(columns: ["Server"])

spec.description: Minimum, average, and maximum results grouped by the Ookla server actually used during the selected time range.
spec.title: Results by Ookla server

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}_status" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "success")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if float(v: int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0 > float(v: "${max_age_seconds}") then 2 else r._value}))

spec.description: Latest recorded attempt in the selected range: success, failure, or stale. No data means unknown; it is not proof of an outage.
spec.title: Latest attempt

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "download_mbps")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

spec.description: Age relative to the end of the selected range (not the current clock when viewing history). No result outside the selected range is assumed.
spec.title: Age of last successful test

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}_status" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "success")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: Each dot is a recorded attempt: green success, red failure. Empty periods are unknown, not success or failure. No interpolation or availability percentage.
spec.title: Collection attempts

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}_status" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "success" or r._field == "error_kind" or r._field == "error_detail" or r._field == "server_id")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.success == 0)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "error_kind", "error_detail", "server_id"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "Time", error_kind: "Reason", error_detail: "Details", server_id: "Requested server"})
  |> sort(columns: ["Time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)

spec.description: Up to 500 most recent failed attempts in the selected range. Includes imported historical errors.
spec.title: Failed attempts — details

spec.name: datasource
spec.label: InfluxDB
spec.description: InfluxDB 2 data source configured to use Flux

spec.name: max_age_seconds
spec.label: Max data age (seconds)
spec.description: Maximum expected gap including execution/retries. Default 4500 for hourly tests; use 1200 for 15-minute tests. Also controls line breaks and stale cards; applies to the selected range end.
